summary_en: Native Yes and No ResetEV/ResetIV branches were observed on exact candidates. ResetIV's party result matches a deterministic stat recalculation from the candidate ROM's personal NARC; only the tested Clefairy is covered. Battery persistence and cold reload were not tested. State lineage was independently resolved through each parent run's recorded output path and hash.
summary_es: Se observaron las ramas nativas Sí y No de ResetEV/ResetIV en las candidatas exactas. El resultado de ResetIV coincide con un recálculo determinista usando el personal NARC de esa ROM; el alcance cubre solo a la Clefairy probada. No se probaron guardado en batería ni recarga en frío. Se resolvió de forma independiente la cadena de estados mediante la ruta y el hash de salida registrados por cada ejecución padre.

reset_iv_derived_expectation.derived_formula: floor((2*base+IV+floor(EV/4))*level/100); HP adds level+10, other stats add 5; Timid nature applies floor(9/10) Attack and floor(11/10) Speed
reset_iv_derived_expectation.hp_policy_observed: current HP remained 22; calculated max HP remained 22

limits: These are bounded native field-script interactions, not broad menu or save compatibility claims.
ResetIV stat derivation is verified only for source slot 0 Clefairy, level 5, PID 0xE30363E2, nature 10, EV zero, IVs [15,3,10,31,21,2].
Every source DSV active party record was decrypted with a valid Pokémon checksum and each DSV MAIN CRC was valid.
A checksum-invalid live RAM record is accepted only when its bytes exactly match a source/plaintext cipher boundary at a two-byte split; no checksum bypass or semantic-only match is used.
No save battery write/cold reload or repeated operation was performed.
The separate no-select attempt is retained as preflight-only; its cause is not verifiable because no result or failure log was retained.
